html:
DocuFlow aims to reduce the hassle of applying for a document. It tells the user all the documents required for an application, so nothing gets missed.

👥 Team Redux

  • Team Lead: Mohammed Fahad — Government Engineering College Palakkad
  • Member 2: Mahir Sahal — Government Engineering College Palakkad
  • Member 3: Mohammed Muflih — Government Engineering College Palakkad

⚙️ Technical details

  • Frontend: Next.js
  • Backend: Express (Node.js) along with Google generative AI (Gemini) API

Live at docuflow-frontend.vercel.app.

Made with ❤️ at Matrix Hackathon 2025 — GEC Palakkad.
